verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs confirm the product ships personal access tokens, and those tokens are used to authenticate to its REST API. That is the product's own token capability, but the evidence never describes limiting a token to specific repositories, choosing granular permissions or scopes, or setting an expiry date. missing for 10: evidence of per-repository/project scoping, granular permission selection, expiry-date configuration, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
